news.headline_zh: 登革病毒本期公共卫生新闻动态
news.lead_zh: 本期登革病毒新闻集中呈现以下动态。
key_findings_zh: 世卫组织通过网络研讨会推出了登革热、基孔肯雅热、寨卡病毒和黄热病等虫媒病毒疾病的临床管理指南。这是与突发卫生事件和疾病 暴发 相关的一系列更广泛活动的一部分。 [news-aaa944e3c48991ee]
登革热病例仍然很低,美属萨摩亚、马绍尔群岛和萨摩亚报告了新病例数。媒介 控制和 监测 工作正在进行中。麻疹和流感警报在多个地点均已启动。 [news-5a482873234602b3]
制造商发布的一项关键试验的长期分析报告显示,疫苗接种 后 4.5 年,对确诊登革热的疗效为 61.2%,对住院治疗的疗效为 84.1%。 [news-dc0ac064355c46a2]
中央药物标准控制组织 (CDSCO) 于 2026 年 7 月批准 Qdenga,一种登革热 疫苗,用于 4 至 60 岁的个体。疫苗 旨在针对 登革病毒 的所有四种血清型(DENV-1 至 DENV-4)。 [news-f1d8aac4d4ca15f8]
佛罗里达州今年已确认 485 例本地感染登革热病例,该州最新的虫媒病毒 监测 报告覆盖 10 月 18 日至 24 日,新增 60 例本地病例。 [news-3bc1673919277118]

news.lead_en: This reporting window highlights the following Dengue virus news developments.
key_findings_en: WHO launched guidelines for the clinical management of arboviral diseases, including dengue, chikungunya, Zika, and yellow fever, through a webinar. This was part of a broader set of activities related to health emergencies and disease outbreaks. [news-aaa944e3c48991ee]

Dengue cases remain low, with new case numbers reported in American Samoa, Marshall Islands, and Samoa. Vector control and surveillance efforts are ongoing. Measles and influenza alerts are active in various locations. [news-5a482873234602b3]

A longer-term analysis of the pivotal trial, published by the manufacturer, reported efficacy of 61.2% against confirmed dengue and 84.1% against hospitalisation 4.5 years after vaccination. [news-dc0ac064355c46a2]

The Central Drugs Standard Control Organisation (CDSCO) approved Qdenga, a dengue vaccine, for individuals aged four to 60 in July 2026. The vaccine is designed to target all four serotypes of the dengue virus (DENV-1 to DENV-4). [news-f1d8aac4d4ca15f8]
Florida has confirmed 485 locally acquired dengue cases this year, with the state's latest arbovirus surveillance report covering October 18 to 24 adding 60 local cases. [news-3bc1673919277118]

papers.title: Evidence of dengue virus exposure among Iranian seafarers: a brief seroprevalence report from Southern Iran
papers.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Dengue virus (DENV) is an emerging public health concern in Iran. Frequent maritime travel between southern Iranian ports and neighboring countries with reported dengue transmission may facilitate the introduction of DENV into Iran. Therefore, this study aimed to determine the seroprevalence of DENV among Iranian seafarers. METHODS: We conducted a cross-sectional serosurvey among 270 seafarers in Bushehr Province. Serum samples were tested for DENV IgM/IgG using ELISA. Travel history and demographics were collected via questionnaires. RESULTS: Serological testing identified 7 DENV-seropositive individuals (2.6%), including 2 IgM-positive and 5 IgG-positive participants. Seropositivity was higher among recent travelers than among past travelers (5.6% vs. Positive cases were detected in Bushehr (5.0%), Asaluyeh (16.7%), Genaveh (5.0%), Kangan (1.7%), and Dayyer (1.3%), whereas no seropositive cases were identified among participants employed in Deylam. CONCLUSIONS: Although DENV seroprevalence remained low among Iranian seafarers, evidence of both recent and past infections indicates that occupational maritime travel may contribute to DENV exposure. Given the strategic role of seafarers in cross-border movement, periodic serological surveillance of this occupational group may facilitate early detection of DENV introduction and strengthen public health preparedness in southern Iran.
papers.journal: Tropical Diseases, Travel Medicine and Vaccines

papers.abstract_zh: 简介:登革病毒 (DENV) 是伊朗新出现的公共卫生问题。伊朗南部港口与报告登革热 传播 的邻国之间频繁的海上旅行可能会促进登革热病毒传入伊朗。因此,本研究旨在确定伊朗海员中 DENV 的 血清流行率。方法:我们对布什尔省的 270 名海员进行了横断面血清调查。使用 ELISA 检测血清样本中的 DENV IgM/IgG。通过问卷调查收集旅行历史和人口统计数据。结果:血清学检测发现 7 名 DENV 血清阳性个体(2.6%),其中 2 名 IgM 阳性和 5 名 IgG 阳性参与者。最近旅行者中的血清阳性率高于过去旅行者中的血清阳性率(5.6%,而在布什尔(5.0%)、阿萨卢耶(16.7%)、杰纳韦(5.0%)、坎甘(1.7%)和代耶尔(1.3%)检测到阳性病例,而在迪拉姆雇用的参与者中没有发现血清阳性病例。结论:尽管伊朗人中的 DENV 血清流行率 仍然较低对于海员来说,最近和过去感染的证据表明,职业性海上旅行可能会导致登革热病毒暴露,鉴于海员在跨境流动中的战略作用,定期对该职业群体进行血清学检测可能有助于及早发现登革热病毒的传入,并加强伊朗南部的公共卫生准备。

papers.title: Regional and Temporal Dynamics of Dengue in Mexico (2020-2024): A Comprehensive Epidemiological Analysis.
papers.abstract: Dengue remains a major public health concern in Mexico, with incidence and clinical burden increasing substantially in recent years. Using national surveillance data from 2020 to 2024, this study provides a comprehensive overview of the changing epidemiological landscape, with an emphasis on geographic distribution, temporal trends, serotype dynamics, and disease severity. Over this period, Mexico saw an almost fivefold increase in dengue cases, reaching over 123,000 confirmed infections and 426 deaths in 2024, the highest annual number recorded. Seasonal patterns shifted, with sustained transmission extending into unusual winter months from late 2023. Serotyping data revealed a shift in predominant virus serotypes, with DENV2 predominating until 2022, DENV1 peaking in 2021, and DENV3 rising sharply from 2022 onward, becoming dominant in 2023 and almost exclusive by 2024. This shift coincided with a sustained rise in dengue with warning signs (from 16.9% in 2020 to > 42% in 2023-2024) and higher hospitalisation rates, while severe dengue remained below 5%. Although DENV3 dominated nationally, DENV1 and DENV2 persisted in specific states, and DENV4 circulated sporadically, particularly in southern and northern regions. Several traditionally low-prevalence states experienced atypical outbreaks, underscoring the potential for sudden epidemic expansion. Climatic analysis showed a consistent positive association between temperature and DENV3 prevalence, with precipitation effects varying by year. Odds ratio analysis suggested serotype-specific differences in severity across years. These findings underscore the heterogeneous and dynamic nature of dengue transmission in Mexico and highlight the need for regional surveillance, prevention, and clinical preparedness strategies.

papers.abstract_zh: 登革热仍然是墨西哥的主要公共卫生问题,近年来其流行程度和临床负担显著增加。本研究利用2020年至2024年的全国登革热数据,全面概述了登革热流行病学景观的变化,重点分析了地理分布、时间趋势、血清型动态以及疾病严重程度。在这一时期,墨西哥的登革热病例数几乎增加了五倍,2024年达到超过123,000例确诊病例和426例死亡,这是有记录以来最高的年度病例数。季节性模式发生了变化,持续的登革热传播从2023年底延伸到了不寻常的冬季月份。血清型数据揭示了主要病毒血清型的变化,DENV2在2022年之前占主导地位,DENV1在2021年达到高峰,而DENV3则从2022年开始急剧上升,成为2023年的主导血清型,并在2024年几乎成为唯一流行的血清型。这种变化与登革热病例数的持续上升以及警告信号的增加(从2020年的16.9%上升到2023-2024年的>42%)相吻合,同时医院入院率也显著提高,而重症登革热病例仍低于5%。尽管DENV3在全国范围内占主导地位,但DENV1和DENV2在某些州仍持续存在,而DENV4则在南部和北部地区偶有流行。一些传统上登革热流行率较低的州出现了非典型的流行模式,突显了登革热暴发可能突然扩展的潜在风险。气候分析显示,温度与DENV3的流行率之间存在一致的正相关关系,而降水的影响则因年份而异。比值比分析表明,不同血清型在不同年份的严重程度存在差异。这些发现突显了墨西哥登革热传播模式的异质性和动态性,并强调了制定区域性监测、预防和临床准备策略的必要性。

analysis_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 审查得出的结论是,墨西哥的登革热 重症登革热 和临床负担大幅增加,到 2024 年 DENV3 将成为主导。审查还指出,重症登革热 病例的比例仍低于 5%,而警告信号显着增加。研究结果强调了登革热 传播 在不同地区和年份的动态和异质性。
analysis_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 审查发现,随着时间的推移,主要血清型发生了变化,从 2022 年起,DENV3 急剧上升。然而,驱动这种转变的确切机制尚未得到充分解释。此外,研究指出,一些传统上低 患病率 的状态经历了非典型的 暴发,但这些变化的原因尚未明确说明。
analysis_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 该综述强调,由于流行病学形势的变化,需要制定区域 监测、预防和临床准备策略。它还表明需要进一步的研究来了解导致血清型优势转变的因素以及某些州非典型 暴发 背后的原因。

papers.title: Tomatidine derivatives suppress Dengue virus infection through entry and post-entry inhibition
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Dengue is a rapidly spreading disease transmitted by mosquitoes and is caused by the Dengue virus (DENV), affecting approximately 390 million individuals globally. Approved vaccines for use have limited efficacy, and there are no approved antivirals. Tomatidine, a steroidal alkaloid obtained from Solanum species, has demonstrated broad-spectrum antiviral properties, leading to the investigation of its derivatives for their anti-DENV activity. In the current study, the anti-DENV potential of tomatidine and 11 such derivatives was assessed using a combination of in vitro and in silico approaches. Vero cells were used to evaluate the cytotoxicity and antiviral effects of the derivatives in pre-, co-, and post-treatment settings. The results indicated that the derivatives 5d, 5f, and 5c possessed the most potent antiviral effects; 5d achieved a 2.81 log decrease in viral RNA, while both 5f and 5c suppressed viral activity under both pre- and post-treatment conditions (5f has a selectivity index of 43.36), including the entry phase, as indicated by the entry assay. Furthermore, effective inhibition was noted between 0 and 9 h post-infection (hpi) and 15–21 hpi via a time-of-addition assay, indicating dual-phase activity. Additionally, docking and molecular dynamics studies revealed stable interactions of compounds 5c and 5d with the non-structural proteins NS1 and NS5–RdRp of DENV, reinforcing the experimental observations. In conclusion, tomatidine derivatives, especially 5d, 5f, and 5c, showed significant potential as anti-DENV therapeutics, necessitating additional mechanistic and in vivo studies to determine their clinical efficacy. IMPORTANCE Dengue is a major global health threat, infecting hundreds of millions of people each year, yet there are no antiviral drugs available for this disease. Identifying safe and effective therapeutics is therefore a global public health priority. In this study, we discovered three promising tomatidine-derived compounds (5d, 5f, and 5c) that markedly reduced Dengue virus replication in laboratory experiments. These compounds acted at multiple stages of the viral life cycle, suggesting that they could both limit the establishment of infection and suppress viral spread after the infection has begun. Computational analyses further indicated that these molecules target key viral proteins while also influencing host pathways that support viral infection, providing insights into how they may exert their antiviral effects. Together, our findings identify tomatidine derivatives as promising lead candidates for dengue antiviral drug development and provide a strong foundation for future preclinical and clinical investigations.

papers.title_zh: 番茄碱衍生物通过进入和进入后抑制来抑制 登革病毒 感染
papers.source_body_en: ABSTRACT Dengue is a rapidly spreading disease transmitted by mosquitoes and is caused by the Dengue virus (DENV), affecting approximately 390 million individuals globally. Approved vaccines for use have limited efficacy, and there are no approved antivirals. Tomatidine, a steroidal alkaloid obtained from Solanum species, has demonstrated broad-spectrum antiviral properties, leading to the investigation of its derivatives for their anti-DENV activity. In the current study, the anti-DENV potential of tomatidine and 11 such derivatives was assessed using a combination of in vitro and in silico approaches. Vero cells were used to evaluate the cytotoxicity and antiviral effects of the derivatives in pre-, co-, and post-treatment settings. The results indicated that the derivatives 5d, 5f, and 5c possessed the most potent antiviral effects; 5d achieved a 2.81 log decrease in viral RNA, while both 5f and 5c suppressed viral activity under both pre- and post-treatment conditions (5f has a selectivity index of 43.36), including the entry phase, as indicated by the entry assay. Furthermore, effective inhibition was noted between 0 and 9 h post-infection (hpi) and 15–21 hpi via a time-of-addition assay, indicating dual-phase activity. Additionally, docking and molecular dynamics studies revealed stable interactions of compounds 5c and 5d with the non-structural proteins NS1 and NS5–RdRp of DENV, reinforcing the experimental observations. In conclusion, tomatidine derivatives, especially 5d, 5f, and 5c, showed significant potential as anti-DENV therapeutics, necessitating additional mechanistic and in vivo studies to determine their clinical efficacy. IMPORTANCE Dengue is a major global health threat, infecting hundreds of millions of people each year, yet there are no antiviral drugs available for this disease. Identifying safe and effective therapeutics is therefore a global public health priority. In this study, we discovered three promising tomatidine-derived compounds (5d, 5f, and 5c) that markedly reduced Dengue virus replication in laboratory experiments. These compounds acted at multiple stages of the viral life cycle, suggesting that they could both limit the establishment of infection and suppress viral spread after the infection has begun. Computational analyses further indicated that these molecules target key viral proteins while also influencing host pathways that support viral infection, providing insights into how they may exert their antiviral effects. Together, our findings identify tomatidine derivatives as promising lead candidates for dengue antiviral drug development and provide a strong foundation for future preclinical and clinical investigations.

papers.title: Epidemiological characteristics and transmission dynamics of dengue in Ningbo City, China before, during, and after the COVID-19 pandemic interventions.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Ningbo experienced a local dengue outbreak in 2018-2019, followed by the implementation and relaxation of COVID-19 pandemic interventions. Evidence has been limited on dengue epidemiology and the transmissibility across these periods. METHODS: We analyzed routine dengue cases and mosquito surveillance data from 2017 to 2024, using descriptive analyses to assess the epidemiological characteristics, and a mathematical model was developed to estimate the basic reproduction number (R0). RESULTS: A total of 266 dengue cases were reported, with no deaths. Before the pandemic interventions, 51.19% of cases were overseas-imported; no cases were reported during pandemic interventions, whereas 73.47% were domestically imported after pandemic interventions. The median age of cases was 38.50 years (IQR = 31.25-54.00), and 57.52% were unemployed, retired, or in commercial services. The onset-to-diagnosis interval shortened post-interventions (4.46 days vs. Viral typing increased post-interventions (34.59% vs. 63.27%), with 83.70% of cases identified as dengue virus-1 infections. Dengue cases were reported across all districts, with higher proportions in Haishu (27.07%) and Yinzhou (24.44%). The incidence was 2.82 per 100,000 persons. Incidence did not differ significantly by sex, but was significantly higher among individuals 15-59 years and those aged ≥60years than among those aged ≤14 years (3.18 and 3.01 per 100,000 persons, respectively, vs. 0.45 per 100,000 persons). Incidence was highest in Haishu and Jiangbei (6.90 and 4.93 per 100,000 persons, respectively). A post-intervention incidence rebound was observed, although no statistically significant differences were observed in the ≤ 14 age group, Beilun District, Ninghai County and Xiangshan County. Aedes albopictus was the only vector species. The mean Breteau Index was 16.07 (SD: 8.04) and decreased across phases, and rebounded in Jiangbei, Zhenhai, and Haishu districts. The mean BI was higher in summer compared to other seasons (p 0.95). The median R0 was higher in the outbreak years (3.46, IQR = 2.98-3.95) than years without local transmission (0.00, IQR = 0.00-0.00; p < 0.001). Median R0 was 0.00 (IQR = 0.00-0.71) over 2017-2024 due to the absence of local cases in most years. CONCLUSIONS: Dengue remains non-endemic in Ningbo, and is driven primarily by imported infections rather than sustained local transmission. Despite a reduction in diagnostic delay and vector density, post-PHSM incidences rebounded, and district-level heterogeneity indicates ongoing outbreak potential. Sustained surveillance, rapid diagnosis and district-tailored vector control are critical to prevent re-establishment of local transmission.

papers.title: Beyond supportive care in pediatric dengue: Emerging therapeutics and the WHO PADO 2026 priorities–A narrative review
papers.abstract: Pediatric dengue remains an important cause of hospitalization and shock in endemic settings, while treatment continues to rely on supportive care. This narrative review critically evaluates investigational direct-acting antivirals, neutralizing monoclonal antibodies, and host-directed agents alongside the World Health Organization (WHO) Paediatric Drug Optimization (PADO) 2026 priorities. PubMed-indexed clinical and mechanistic literature and WHO guidance available through October 2026 informed a selective synthesis. NS4B and NS5 inhibitors provide convincing mechanistic signals, but early viral suppression has not been shown to prevent severe dengue in children. Mosnodenvir reduced viral RNA in a controlled human infection study conducted as prophylaxis in healthy adults; this does not establish efficacy in symptomatic pediatric infection, and resistance is a concern. In a randomized trial involving 250 adults, dengue-mAb (formerly VIS513) accelerated infectious-virus and fever clearance, but prevention of shock, organ dysfunction, and hospitalization was not established. Pediatric translation also depends on immune history, abrupt defervescence-associated vascular leakage, age-dependent physiology, the feasibility of very early treatment, and the safety of antibody-based interventions, not merely dose adjustment. PADO prioritizes SII dengue-mAb and places AV-1, EYU-688, fenretinide, and mosnodenvir on its watch list. Virological endpoints remain useful for early development; pediatric trials must ultimately demonstrate sustained clinical recovery or prevention of deterioration with acceptable safety and deployable regimens. No investigational agent reviewed is currently established for routine pediatric dengue treatment.
papers.journal: Asian Pacific Journal of Tropical Medicine

analysis.summary_en: This narrative review evaluates emerging therapeutics for pediatric dengue, focusing on direct-acting antivirals, neutralizing monoclonal antibodies, and host-directed agents. The review highlights that while NS4B and NS5 inhibitors show promising mechanistic signals, they have not been proven to prevent severe dengue in children. Mosnodenvir demonstrated reduced viral RNA in adults but lacks evidence for pediatric use and faces resistance concerns. The World Health Organization (WHO) Paediatric Drug Optimization (PADO) 2026 priorities emphasize the need for pediatric-specific trials to demonstrate sustained clinical recovery and safety. No investigational agent is currently established for routine pediatric dengue treatment. The review underscores the importance of considering immune history, vascular leakage, age-dependent physiology, and treatment timing in pediatric dengue management.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 儿童登革热仍然是流行病环境下住院和休克的重要原因,而 治疗 继续依赖支持性护理。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 这篇叙述性综述批判性地评估了研究中的直接作用 抗病毒药物、中和单克隆抗体和 宿主 定向药物以及世界卫生组织 (WHO) 儿科药物优化 (PADO) 2026 年优先事项。截至 2026 年 10 月,PubMed 索引的临床和机制文献以及 WHO 指南提供了选择性综合信息。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: NS4B 和 NS5 抑制剂提供了令人信服的机制信号,但早期病毒抑制尚未被证明可以预防儿童 重症登革热。病毒学终点对于早期开发仍然有用;儿科试验必须最终证明具有可接受的安全性和可部署的治疗方案的持续临床恢复或预防恶化。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 在一项针对健康成人的对照人类感染研究中,Mosnodenvir 可减少病毒 RNA;这并不能确定对有症状的儿科感染的疗效,并且耐药性是一个问题。目前尚未确定用于常规儿科登革热 治疗 的研究药物。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 儿科转化还取决于免疫史、突然退热相关的血管渗漏、年龄依赖性生理学、早期 治疗 的可行性以及基于抗体的干预措施的安全性,而不仅仅是剂量调整。

papers.title: Metabolic Screening and In Silico Investigation of Eucalyptus globulus Essential Oil Bioactives Against DENV-2 Envelope Protein.
papers.abstract: The escalating prevalence of viral infectious diseases poses a significant threat to global public health. Among these, dengue virus (DENV) represents one of the most widespread arboviral infections, impacting nearly 400 million individuals annually, with severe clinical manifestations occurring in approximately 1% of cases, as reported by the World Health Organization (WHO). Extensive research across both academic and industrial sectors has focused on various aspects of DENV, including its molecular virology, epidemiological patterns, transmission pathways, and therapeutic targets. The development of the tetravalent CYD-TDV (Dengvaxia) vaccine marked a critical advancement in dengue prevention. Nonetheless, emerging evidence has highlighted several limitations associated with current vaccination strategies, prompting a growing emphasis on the discovery and development of antiviral agents as alternative or complementary therapeutic options for effective dengue management. A total of 14 major bioactive compounds were found to be highly correlated with Dengue, yielding 70 common targets between dengue and bioactive compounds. Protein-protein interaction and network pathway analysis by KEGG and Metascape analysis show higher degree of correlation for DENV-2 targets. Molecular docking analysis shows that Globulol and Ecalyptol have higher binding affinity with two receptors, 1oke and 1tg8 f DENV-2, with binding energies of -8.3 and -7.6. Toxicity and drug-likeness analyses confirmed the safety of the metabolites for drug development. These findings suggest that Eucalyptus globulus essential oil may have potential in the treatment of dengue fever. However, further in vivo studies using animal models are required to validate its therapeutic efficacy.

papers.source_body_en: The escalating prevalence of viral infectious diseases poses a significant threat to global public health. Among these, dengue virus (DENV) represents one of the most widespread arboviral infections, impacting nearly 400 million individuals annually, with severe clinical manifestations occurring in approximately 1% of cases, as reported by the World Health Organization (WHO). Extensive research across both academic and industrial sectors has focused on various aspects of DENV, including its molecular virology, epidemiological patterns, transmission pathways, and therapeutic targets. The development of the tetravalent CYD-TDV (Dengvaxia) vaccine marked a critical advancement in dengue prevention. Nonetheless, emerging evidence has highlighted several limitations associated with current vaccination strategies, prompting a growing emphasis on the discovery and development of antiviral agents as alternative or complementary therapeutic options for effective dengue management. A total of 14 major bioactive compounds were found to be highly correlated with Dengue, yielding 70 common targets between dengue and bioactive compounds. Protein-protein interaction and network pathway analysis by KEGG and Metascape analysis show higher degree of correlation for DENV-2 targets. Molecular docking analysis shows that Globulol and Ecalyptol have higher binding affinity with two receptors, 1oke and 1tg8 f DENV-2, with binding energies of -8.3 and -7.6. Toxicity and drug-likeness analyses confirmed the safety of the metabolites for drug development. These findings suggest that Eucalyptus globulus essential oil may have potential in the treatment of dengue fever. However, further in vivo studies using animal models are required to validate its therapeutic efficacy.

papers.title: Epidemiología y prevención del dengue mediante el control de criaderos del vector en comunidades endémicas en América Latina.
papers.abstract: Dengue is a viral disease transmitted by Aedes aegypti, constituting a major public health problem in Latin America due to its high epidemiological burden accompanied by factors that favor its proliferation. The objective of this systematic review was to analyze the epidemiology and prevention of dengue and the control of breeding sites in endemic communities. The results showed a wide circulation of the serotypes DENV-1, DENV-2, DENV-3 and DENV-4, with a predominance of dengue without warning signs with prevalence’s greater than 90%. Among the main factors associated with the proliferation of the vector were climatic conditions, unplanned urbanization, accumulation of water containers, inadequate water storage, deficiencies in sanitation, and low levels of health education. Regarding preventive strategies, integrated interventions proved most effective in reducing cases, particularly targeted indoor residual spraying, epidemiological surveillance, and community participation, complemented by environmental management in communities through the control of breeding sites. It is concluded that dengue prevention requires sustainable vector control programs that integrate surveillance, biotechnological innovation, and community participation to reduce disease transmission in endemic areas.

papers.abstract_zh: 登革热是一种由埃及伊蚊传播的病毒性疾病,由于其高流行病学负担以及有利于其扩散的因素,已成为拉丁美洲的一个主要公共卫生问题。本系统评价的目的是分析 流行病学 和登革热预防以及流行社区繁殖地的控制。结果显示,DENV-1、DENV-2、DENV-3和DENV-4血清型广泛传播,其中以无预警信号的登革热为主,患病率的比例大于90%。与媒介扩散相关的主要因素包括气候条件、无计划的城市化、水容器的堆积、储水不足、卫生设施缺陷以及健康教育水平低。在预防策略方面,综合干预措施被证明对减少病例最为有效,特别是有针对性的室内滞留喷洒、流行病学监测和社区参与,并辅以通过控制繁殖地进行的社区环境管理。结论是,登革热预防需要可持续的 媒介 控制计划,将 监测、生物技术创新和社区参与结合起来,以减少流行地区的疾病 监测。

papers.title: Serotype-structured force of infection for optimizing dengue vaccine trial design
papers.abstract: Dengue fever, transmitted primarily by Aedes aegypti, remains a major global public health threat, causing an estimated 390 million infections annually. Designing efficient dengue vaccine efficacy trials in endemic regions is challenging because transmission intensity varies across space and time, baseline population immunity is heterogeneous, and endpoint accrual depends strongly on the local force of infection (FoI). We developed a simulation framework for trial planning in endemic settings that links FoI to age-specific seroprevalence through a catalytic model and then translates FoI into symptomatic endpoint incidence for randomized controlled trial simulations. Across a range of FoI scenarios representing low-to-high endemic transmission, we evaluated sample size requirements, follow-up duration, and expected power under alternative vaccine efficacy assumptions. In high-transmission settings, the framework indicates that trials enrolling 5,000-10,000 participants per arm can achieve at least 80% power within 12-24 months of follow-up under plausible symptomatic detection assumptions. Sensitivity analyses demonstrate that feasibility thresholds are most sensitive to FoI and the symptomatic fraction, highlighting the importance of site selection and surveillance intensity. Overall, the proposed FoI-based approach provides practical guidance for dengue trial design, including sample size determination, follow-up planning, and the identification of epidemiological conditions under which vaccine evaluation is most efficient in endemic settings.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: Dengue fever, transmitted primarily by Aedes aegypti, remains a major global public health threat, causing an estimated 390 million infections annually.
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 在流行地区设计有效的登革热 疫苗 疗效试验具有挑战性,因为 传播 强度随空间和时间的不同而变化,基线群体免疫具有异质性,并且终点累积很大程度上取决于当地感染力 (FoI)。
elements_zh.methods: 我们开发了一个用于流行环境中试验计划的模拟框架,通过催化模型将 FoI 与特定年龄的 血清流行率 联系起来,然后将 FoI 转化为症状终点 发病率 以进行随机对照试验模拟。
elements_zh.main_results: 在代表低流行 疫苗 的一系列 FoI 场景中,我们评估了样本量要求、随访持续时间以及替代 疫苗 功效假设下的预期功效。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该框架表明,在合理的症状检测假设下,每组招募 5,000-10,000 名参与者的试验在随访 12-24 个月内可以达到至少 80% 的效果。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 敏感性分析表明,可行性阈值对 FoI 和症状分数最敏感,突出了地点选择和 监测 强度的重要性。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 总体而言,所提出的基于 FoI 的方法为登革热试验设计提供了实用指导,包括样本量确定、后续计划以及流行病学条件的确定,在这些条件下,疫苗 评估在流行环境中最有效。

papers.title: A combinatorial probe-coding multiplex RT-qPCR assay for simultaneous detection and differentiation of dengue, Zika, and chikungunya viruses in human and mosquito samples
papers.abstract: Abstract Arboviruses such as Zika virus (ZIKV), dengue virus (DENV), and chikungunya virus (CHIKV) remain significant public health threats in tropical and subtropical regions. These viruses are transmitted primarily by Aedes mosquitoes and often co-circulate in the same geographic areas, leading to outbreaks with overlapping clinical presentations and cross-reactivity in serological testing, particularly between ZIKV and DENV. These aspects create diagnostic challenges, and the development of molecular diagnostic methods is critically necessary. Here, we developed a diagnostic kit based on the Multicolor Combinational Probe Coding (MCPC) concept to simultaneously detect six viral targets (ZIKV, DENV1–4, and CHIKV) and an internal control (IC), by encoding targets with four spectrally distinct dyes. Using a panel of 660 characterized human serum or plasma samples, and 9 artificial DENV-4 samples, we obtained diagnostic sensitivity and specificity above 94% and 99%, respectively, for all targets. The assay enables the simultaneous analysis of up to 91 samples, substantially increasing testing throughput compared to commercially available products. The test was also applied to mosquito specimens of Aedes spp., Anopheles spp., Haemagogus spp., and Culex spp., demonstrating its utility as a robust tool not only for emergency response but also for arbovirus surveillance in public health settings.
authors: Arabela Leal e Silva de Mello

papers.title: Molecular Characterization of a Saudi Arabian DENV-3 Isolate and Identification of Potential Inhibitors Targeting Dengue Virus Proteins.
papers.abstract: INTRODUCTION: The dengue virus (DENV) is a globally significant pathogenic virus. Understanding the genetic characteristics of the DENV is critical to elucidating viral evolution, diversity, and transmission. Furthermore, investigating DENV evolution using advanced molecular approaches can facilitate the identification of new genotypes and expand our knowledge of the DENV proteome, thereby supporting the development of novel therapeutics. Our study examines a DENV-3 isolate sequence at the molecular level and seeks to identify a potential inhibitor targeting crucial DENV proteins. METHOD: Serum samples collected from confirmed dengue cases in Saudi Arabia (2024) were analysed to characterize crucial targets for potential antiviral development. We performed multiple sequence alignment, phylogenetic analysis, virtual screening, molecular docking, and ligand-protein interaction analysis. RESULTS: DENV-3 isolate is similar to the DENV virus from a Saudi Arabian isolate from 2016 (MZ857217.1), as demonstrated by phylogenetic research. The findings reveal a stable secondary structure of targets and identify at least four leading chemical compounds as anti-dengue therapeutic candidates that have higher predicted affinities toward the targets compared to the control. CONCLUSION: These findings enhance our molecular-level understanding of recent dengue isolates in Saudi Arabia and contribute to the development of antiviral medicines. They may inform future therapeutic strategies and outbreak management efforts.

elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究的解释强调了分子方法在理解 DENV 进化 和扩展其蛋白质组知识方面的重要性。这有助于新疗法的开发。

elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究因其对计算方法的依赖和缺乏实验验证而受到限制。由于使用了虚拟筛选和对接技术,证据的强度中等。

papers.abstract_zh: 简介:登革病毒 (DENV) 是一种全球重要的致病病毒。了解 DENV 的遗传特征对于阐明病毒 进化、多样性和 进化 至关重要。此外,使用先进的分子方法研究 DENV 进化 可以促进新基因型的鉴定并扩展我们对 DENV 蛋白质组的了解,从而支持新疗法的开发。我们的研究在分子水平上检查了 DENV-3 分离序列,并寻求识别针对关键 DENV 蛋白的潜在抑制剂。方法:分析从沙特阿拉伯(2024 年)确诊的登革热病例中收集的血清样本,以确定潜在 抗病毒药物 开发的关键目标。我们进行了多重序列比对、系统发育分析、虚拟筛选、分子对接和配体-蛋白质相互作用分析。结果:系统发育研究证明,DENV-3 分离株与 2016 年沙特阿拉伯分离株 (MZ857217.1) 的 DENV 病毒相似。研究结果揭示了目标的稳定二级结构,并确定了至少四种主要化合物作为抗登革热治疗候选物,与对照相比,它们对目标具有更高的预测亲和力。结论:这些发现增强了我们对沙特阿拉伯近期登革热分离株的分子水平了解,并有助于 抗病毒药物 药物的开发。它们可以为未来的治疗策略和 暴发 管理工作提供信息。

papers.title: Transmission Dynamics of Dengue Virus, Ceará State, Brazil, 2010–2025
papers.abstract: We evaluated the transmission dynamics of dengue virus (DENV) during 2010–2025 in Ceará State, Brazil. Ceará has been a dengue hyperendemic region, where all 4 DENV serotypes co-circulate, predominantly DENV-1 and DENV-2, and where DENV-3 was recently reintroduced. Our findings provide an epidemiologic baseline for postlicensure dengue vaccine evaluation.

papers.title: Circulating Zika and dengue IgA-NS1 marks early postnatal exposure without significant association with congenital Zika syndrome-related microcephaly.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Elevated preexisting maternal IgG-NS1 to DENV, rather than to ZIKV, has been associated with a reduced risk of microcephaly in congenital Zika syndrome (CZS), suggesting a protective role. While serological analysis of IgG and IgM has physiological limitations in infants, IgA-NS1 represents a marker of host exposure to orthoflavivirus, as it is not transferred transplacentally and reflects early active immune responses. This study evaluated circulating IgA-NS1 responses to ZIKV and DENV in mothers and infants prenatally exposed to ZIKV in southern Colombia, a dengue hyperendemic region. METHODS: In this multicentric study, we analyzed 164 mother-infant pairs with confirmed gestational ZIKV exposure during the Colombia 2015-2016 epidemic. Using optimized ELISAs with well-characterized clinical samples, we simultaneously assessed circulating IgA-NS1 responses against ZIKV and DENV1-4. Neurological outcomes were evaluated through pediatric follow-up to determine associations between IgA-NS1 and CZS-related microcephaly. RESULTS: IgA-NS1 ELISAs for ZIKV and DENV1-4 achieved sensitivity/specificity of 94%/97% and 86%/85%, respectively. DENV-exposed samples showed 26% cross-reactivity against ZIKV NS1. There was no evidence of placental transfer, and IgA-NS1 levels for ZIKV and DENV were comparable between mothers and infants with or without CZS-related microcephaly. However, circulating ZIKV and DENV IgA-NS1 increased postnatally and were higher in older children. CONCLUSION: While circulating IgA-NS1 serves as a promising postnatal marker of orthoflavivirus exposure in infants due to its stability and lack of placental transfer, it does not appear to contribute to protection against severe CZS outcomes. These findings demonstrate that protective NS1-mediated immunity against microcephaly may be isotype-dependent.

source_records.title: Circulating Zika and dengue IgA-NS1 marks early postnatal exposure without significant association with congenital Zika syndrome-related microcephaly
source_records.abstract: BACKGROUND: Elevated preexisting maternal IgG-NS1 to DENV, rather than to ZIKV, has been associated with a reduced risk of microcephaly in congenital Zika syndrome (CZS), suggesting a protective role. elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在评估产前暴露于 ZIKV 的母亲和婴儿对 ZIKV 和 DENV 的循环 IgA-NS1 反应,解决了解产后早期暴露标志物及其与先天性寨卡综合征相关小头畸形的关系的需要。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 一项多中心研究分析了 2015-2016 年哥伦比亚流行期间确认妊娠期感染 ZIKV 的 164 对母婴,重点关注登革热高流行地区产前暴露的婴儿。
elements_zh.methods: 使用经过充分表征的临床样本进行优化的 ELISA 来评估针对 ZIKV 和 DENV1-4 的循环 IgA-NS1 反应,并通过儿科随访评估神经学结果,以确定与 CZS 相关小头畸形的关联。
elements_zh.main_results: ZIKV 和 DENV1-4 的 IgA-NS1 ELISA 的灵敏度/特异性分别为 94%/97% 和 86%/85%。DENV 暴露样本与 ZIKV NS1 表现出 26% 的交叉反应性。没有胎盘转移的证据,并且患有或不患有 CZS 相关小头畸形的母亲和婴儿之间的 ZIKV 和 DENV IgA-NS1 水平相当。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,由于其稳定性和缺乏胎盘转移,循环 IgA-NS1 可以作为婴儿正黄病毒暴露的有希望的产后标志物,但它似乎无助于预防严重的 CZS 结局。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现告知使用 IgA-NS1 作为婴儿正黄病毒暴露的产后标志物,这可能有助于 监测 以及 ZIKV 和 DENV 感染的早期检测,尽管它们并没有直接告知针对严重先天性寨卡综合征结果的保护措施。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的证据因其关注特定地理区域和单一时间段而受到限制,结果表明 IgA-NS1 可能不是针对严重 CZS 结局的保护性标志物,表明对研究结果的可信度中等。

papers.abstract_zh: 背景:预先存在的母体 IgG-NS1 对 DENV(而非 ZIKV)的升高与先天性寨卡综合征 (CZS) 中小头畸形的风险降低相关,表明具有保护作用。虽然 IgG 和 IgM 的血清学分析在婴儿中存在生理局限性,但 IgA-NS1 代表了 宿主 暴露于正黄病毒的标志物,因为它不会经胎盘转移并反映早期活跃的 免疫应答。这项研究评估了哥伦比亚南部(登革热高流行区)产前暴露于 ZIKV 的母亲和婴儿对 ZIKV 和 DENV 的循环 IgA-NS1 反应。方法:在这项多中心研究中,我们分析了 2015-2016 年哥伦比亚流行期间确认妊娠期寨卡病毒暴露的 164 对母婴。我们使用优化的 ELISA 和充分表征的临床样本,同时评估了针对 ZIKV 和 DENV1-4 的循环 IgA-NS1 反应。通过儿科随访评估神经学结果,以确定 IgA-NS1 与 CZS 相关小头畸形之间的关联。结果:针对 ZIKV 和 DENV1-4 的 IgA-NS1 ELISA 的灵敏度/特异性分别为 94%/97% 和 86%/85%。DENV 暴露样本与 ZIKV NS1 表现出 26% 的交叉反应性。没有胎盘转移的证据,并且患有或不患有 CZS 相关小头畸形的母亲和婴儿之间的 ZIKV 和 DENV IgA-NS1 水平相当。然而,循环中的 ZIKV 和 DENV IgA-NS1 在出生后增加,并且在年龄较大的儿童中更高。结论:虽然循环 IgA-NS1 由于其稳定性和缺乏胎盘转移而成为婴儿正黄病毒暴露的有前途的产后标志物,但它似乎无助于预防严重的 CZS 结局。这些发现表明,NS1 介导的针对小头畸形的保护性免疫可能具有同种型依赖性。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在评估产前暴露于 ZIKV 的母亲和婴儿对 ZIKV 和 DENV 的循环 IgA-NS1 反应,解决了解产后早期暴露标志物及其与先天性寨卡综合征相关小头畸形的关系的需要。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 一项多中心研究分析了 2015-2016 年哥伦比亚流行期间确认妊娠期感染 ZIKV 的 164 对母婴,重点关注登革热高流行地区产前暴露的婴儿。
analysis_zh.methods: 使用经过充分表征的临床样本进行优化的 ELISA 来评估针对 ZIKV 和 DENV1-4 的循环 IgA-NS1 反应,并通过儿科随访评估神经学结果,以确定与 CZS 相关小头畸形的关联。

analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,由于其稳定性和缺乏胎盘转移,循环 IgA-NS1 可以作为婴儿正黄病毒暴露的有希望的产后标志物,但它似乎无助于预防严重的 CZS 结局。

papers.title: Solanaceae-Derived Spirostane Saponins Inhibit Dengue Virus Replication and Viral Protein Expression and Exhibit Activity Against Multiple Arboviruses.
papers.abstract: Mosquito-borne arboviruses, including dengue virus (DENV), Zika virus (ZIKV), and chikungunya virus (CHIKV), represent a growing global health burden, yet no specific antiviral therapies are currently available for most of these infections. This unmet need highlights the importance of identifying novel antiviral compounds from biologically relevant sources such as plant-derived natural products. In this study, a bioactivity-guided approach was applied to methanolic extracts from eight Solanaceae species to identify compounds with antiviral activity against DENV-2 in Vero cells. Five extracts significantly reduced viral infectivity, with Solanum ovalifolium and Cestrum sp. achieving complete inhibition at non-cytotoxic concentrations. Subsequent fractionation and purification led to the isolation of four spirostane-type steroidal saponins, structurally characterized by UPLC-DAD-MS and 1D/2D NMR spectroscopy. Functional assays demonstrated that these compounds inhibit DENV replication, as evidenced by marked reductions in viral RNA levels, NS1 and NS3 protein expression, and infectious viral titers. Stage-specific analyses revealed that their antiviral activity is primarily associated with intracellular phases of the viral life cycle, consistent with inhibition of viral replication and/or protein processing. Molecular docking analyses supported these findings by predicting favorable interactions with key viral enzymes, particularly NS5 RNA-dependent RNA polymerase and NS3 helicase/protease. Importantly, the isolated compounds retained antiviral activity against ZIKV and CHIKV, indicating cross-arboviral efficacy. Together, these findings identify spirostane saponins as promising antiviral scaffolds and support their further development as broad-spectrum antiviral agents.

papers.abstract_zh: 蚊媒虫媒病毒(包括登革病毒(DENV)、寨卡病毒(ZIKV)和基孔肯雅病毒(CHIKV))构成了日益增长的全球健康负担,但目前针对这些感染的特异性抗病毒药物疗法尚不普及。这种未满足的医疗需求凸显了从生物相关来源(如植物来源的天然产物)中识别新型抗病毒药物化合物的重要性。本研究采用基于生物活性的筛选方法,对八种茄科植物的甲醇提取物进行分析,以鉴定具有抗病毒药物活性的化合物,针对Vero细胞中DENV-2的感染。五种提取物显著降低了病毒的感染性,其中Solanum ovalifolium和Cestrum sp.在非细胞毒性浓度下实现了完全抑制。随后的分级和纯化过程分离出四种螺甾烷型甾体皂苷,其结构通过超高效液相色谱-二极管阵列检测-质谱(UPLC-DAD-MS)和一维/二维核磁共振(1D/2D NMR)光谱进行表征。功能实验表明,这些化合物抑制DENV复制,表现为病毒RNA水平、NS1和NS3蛋白表达以及传染性病毒滴度的显著下降。阶段特异性分析显示,其抗病毒药物活性主要与病毒生命周期的细胞内阶段相关,这与抑制病毒复制和/或蛋白质加工一致。分子对接分析支持这些发现,预测这些化合物与关键病毒酶(特别是NS5 RNA依赖性RNA聚合酶和NS3解旋酶/蛋白酶)具有有利的相互作用。重要的是,分离出的化合物对ZIKV和CHIKV也表现出抗病毒药物活性,表明其具有跨虫媒病毒的疗效。综上所述,这些发现表明螺甾烷皂苷是具有前景的抗病毒药物骨架,并支持其进一步开发为广谱抗病毒药物药物。

papers.title: Dengue Virus Serotype 2 Infection Transcriptionally Reprograms Host Neutrophils to Establish an Immunosuppressive Microenvironment in Mice
papers.abstract: Abstract Dengue virus (DV) infection triggers profound alterations in host immune responses, yet the transcriptomic reprogramming of innate immune cells during disease progression remains incompletely understood. Here, we demonstrated that Dengue virus serotype 2 (DV-2) infection transcriptionally reprograms host neutrophils, establishing an immunosuppressive microenvironment that facilitates pathogenesis. Through scRNA transcriptomic profiling of bone marrow and spleen cells from the DV-2-infected AG129 mouse model, we delineated a distinct neutrophil signature that shows dynamic shifts in immature and activated populations over the course of dengue infection. We also characterized a specific Ly6G low subpopulation, notably Fibrinogen-like protein 2 (FGL2)-expressing subsets, that appeared with disease progression. Serum FGL2 levels were significantly elevated in both DV-2-infected mice and human dengue-positive patients. Furthermore, treatment of splenocytes with FGL2 or FGL2-enriched neutrophil secretomes suppressed T cell functional activity and promoted an immunosuppressive phenotype. Together, these findings reveal how DV-2-driven neutrophil reprogramming shapes an immunosuppressive network, highlighting the importance of studying FGL2-expressing neutrophil subsets to understand dengue immunopathogenesis. Added value of this study This study provides the single-cell transcriptomic map of neutrophil heterogeneity during dengue virus serotype 2 infection in a mouse model, uncovering a critical temporal shift from early protective subsets to a severe-stage, immunosuppressive Ly6G low and immature subpopulation. Progression triggers an abnormal cell subpopulation (Ly6G low ) that secretes the soluble protein Fibrinogen-like protein 2 (FGL2) and suppresses T cell functional activity, promoting an immunosuppressive phenotype. By validating elevated plasma FGL2 levels in human dengue patients, this work identifies Ly6G low neutrophil subsets that secrete FGL2 as a possible mediator of immunosuppression in severe dengue in the mouse model.

source_records.abstract: Dengue virus (DV) infection triggers profound alterations in host immune responses, yet the transcriptomic reprogramming of innate immune cells during disease progression remains incompletely understood. Here, we demonstrated that Dengue virus serotype 2 (DV-2) infection transcriptionally reprograms host neutrophils, establishing an immunosuppressive microenvironment that facilitates pathogenesis. Through scRNA transcriptomic profiling of bone marrow and spleen cells from the DV-2-infected AG129 mouse model, we delineated a distinct neutrophil signature that shows dynamic shifts in immature and activated populations over the course of dengue infection. We also characterized a specific Ly6Glow subpopulation, notably Fibrinogen-like protein 2 (FGL2)-expressing subsets, that appeared with disease progression. Serum FGL2 levels were significantly elevated in both DV-2-infected mice and human dengue-positive patients. Furthermore, treatment of splenocytes with FGL2 or FGL2-enriched neutrophil secretomes suppressed T cell functional activity and promoted an immunosuppressive phenotype. Together, these findings reveal how DV-2-driven neutrophil reprogramming shapes an immunosuppressive network, highlighting the importance of studying FGL2-expressing neutrophil subsets to understand dengue immunopathogenesis. Added value of this study This study provides the single-cell transcriptomic map of neutrophil heterogeneity during dengue virus serotype 2 infection in a mouse model, uncovering a critical temporal shift from early protective subsets to a severe-stage, immunosuppressive Ly6Glow and immature subpopulation. Progression triggers an abnormal cell subpopulation (Ly6Glow) that secretes the soluble protein Fibrinogen-like protein 2 (FGL2) and suppresses T cell functional activity, promoting an immunosuppressive phenotype. By validating elevated plasma FGL2 levels in human dengue patients, this work identifies Ly6Glow neutrophil subsets that secrete FGL2 as a possible mediator of immunosuppression in severe dengue in the mouse model.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to understand the transcriptional reprogramming of host neutrophils during dengue virus serotype 2 (DV-2) infection, addressing the incompletely understood alterations in host immune responses during dengue virus infection.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study used an AG129 mouse model to investigate the effects of DV-2 infection on neutrophils, focusing on the scRNA transcriptomic profiling of bone marrow and spleen cells.
analysis.methods: Single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) was employed to profile the transcriptomic changes in neutrophils during DV-2 infection, identifying distinct neutrophil signatures and subsets.
analysis.main_results: DV-2 infection was found to reprogram neutrophils, leading to the emergence of a Ly6G low subpopulation that expresses Fibrinogen-like protein 2 (FGL2) and suppresses T cell functional activity, establishing an immunosuppressive microenvironment.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The study revealed a novel mechanism by which DV-2 infection reprograms neutrophils to suppress immune responses, highlighting the importance of FGL2-expressing neutrophil subsets in dengue immunopathogenesis.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These findings could inform the development of therapeutic strategies targeting FGL2-expressing neutrophils to mitigate dengue immunosuppression and improve patient outcomes.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study's limitations include the use of a mouse model, which may not fully represent human dengue infection, and the need for further validation in human samples.

analysis.summary_en: This study used scRNA-seq to show that DV-2 infection reprograms neutrophils, leading to the emergence of an immunosuppressive Ly6G low subpopulation that suppresses T cell activity, potentially informing future therapeutic strategies.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在了解 宿主 中性粒细胞在 登革病毒 血清型 2 (DV-2) 感染期间的转录重编程,解决 宿主 免疫应答 在 登革病毒 感染期间不完全了解的变化。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究使用 AG129 小鼠模型来研究 DV-2 感染对中性粒细胞的影响,重点关注骨髓和脾细胞的 scRNA 转录组分析。
elements_zh.methods: 采用单细胞 RNA 测序 (scRNA-seq) 来分析 DV-2 感染期间中性粒细胞的转录组变化,识别不同的中性粒细胞特征和子集。
elements_zh.main_results: 研究发现,DV-2 感染可重新编程中性粒细胞,导致 Ly6G 低亚群的出现,表达纤维蛋白原样蛋白 2 (FGL2) 并抑制 T 细胞功能活性,从而建立免疫抑制微环境。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究揭示了 DV-2 感染重新编程中性粒细胞以抑制 免疫应答 的新机制,强调了表达 FGL2 的中性粒细胞亚群在登革热免疫发病机制中的重要性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以为针对表达 FGL2 的中性粒细胞的治疗策略的开发提供信息,以减轻登革热免疫抑制并改善患者的预后。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的局限性包括使用小鼠模型,该模型可能无法完全代表人类登革热感染,并且需要在人类样本中进行进一步验证。

papers.title: Acute Transverse Myelitis as a Rare Neurological Complication of Dengue Fever: A Case Report
papers.abstract: Abstract Background/ Introduction Dengue is a blood borne disease having a consistent presentation of fever, myalgia and thrombocytopenia while neurological involvement in dengue is rarely reported. This case report presents a rare case of dengue induced acute transverse myelitis (ATM) emphasizing the importance of early diagnosis and prompt treatment to prevent permanent neurological deficits. Case presentation The patient presented with fever, retro orbital pain and vomiting. A blood sample for dengue serology including IgM and IgG were positive. Later on, he developed sudden onset of paraplegia of lower limbs and loss of sensations below the level of umbilicus. Neurological examination revealed a power of zero in both lower limbs, positive Babinski sign, brisk lower limb reflexes and loss of control of bowel and bladder. Magnetic resonance imaging of the spinal cord revealed diffuse hyper intense signals. A possible diagnosis of ATM was made due to concurrent dengue infection and lack of other findings suggesting a diagnosis other than dengue. He was treated with IV methylprednisolone and tocilizumab and his condition started improving gradually. Conclusion This case underscores ATM as a rare yet reversible neurological complication of dengue fever. Early recognition and diagnosis through neuroimaging and exclusion of other causes, followed by timely initiation of high-dose corticosteroids and immunomodulatory therapy, can lead to favorable outcomes. Awareness of this association is very crucial in endemic regions of dengue to ensure prompt treatment and optimal recovery.

analysis.research_question_and_background: This study aimed to highlight the rare neurological complication of dengue fever, specifically acute transverse myelitis, and its potential impact on patient outcomes.
analysis.study_design_and_population: This case report describes a single patient with dengue fever who developed acute transverse myelitis, emphasizing the clinical presentation and diagnostic process.
analysis.methods: The patient's condition was assessed through clinical evaluation, dengue serology testing, and magnetic resonance imaging of the spinal cord to confirm the diagnosis of acute transverse myelitis.
analysis.main_results: Dengue serology tests were positive for IgM and IgG, and magnetic resonance imaging revealed diffuse hyper intense signals in the spinal cord. The patient experienced sudden onset of paraplegia and loss of sensations below the umbilicus.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret this case as an example of a rare yet reversible neurological complication of dengue fever, underscoring the need for early diagnosis and treatment.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: This case highlights the importance of recognizing dengue-induced neurological complications in endemic regions to ensure timely intervention and improve patient recovery.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to a single case report, which may not be generalizable. However, the evidence is strong given the clear clinical and diagnostic findings.

analysis.summary_en: This case report describes a rare neurological complication of dengue fever, specifically acute transverse myelitis, in a single patient. The patient presented with fever, retro orbital pain, and vomiting, followed by sudden paraplegia and loss of sensations below the umbilicus. Dengue serology tests were positive, and magnetic resonance imaging of the spinal cord showed diffuse hyper intense signals. The authors emphasize the importance of early diagnosis and treatment with corticosteroids and immunomodulatory therapy to prevent permanent neurological deficits. papers.title_zh: 急性横贯性脊髓炎是 登革热 的罕见神经系统并发症:病例报告
papers.source_body_en: Abstract Background/ Introduction Dengue is a blood borne disease having a consistent presentation of fever, myalgia and thrombocytopenia while neurological involvement in dengue is rarely reported. This case report presents a rare case of dengue induced acute transverse myelitis (ATM) emphasizing the importance of early diagnosis and prompt treatment to prevent permanent neurological deficits. Case presentation The patient presented with fever, retro orbital pain and vomiting. A blood sample for dengue serology including IgM and IgG were positive. Later on, he developed sudden onset of paraplegia of lower limbs and loss of sensations below the level of umbilicus. Neurological examination revealed a power of zero in both lower limbs, positive Babinski sign, brisk lower limb reflexes and loss of control of bowel and bladder. Magnetic resonance imaging of the spinal cord revealed diffuse hyper intense signals. A possible diagnosis of ATM was made due to concurrent dengue infection and lack of other findings suggesting a diagnosis other than dengue. He was treated with IV methylprednisolone and tocilizumab and his condition started improving gradually. Conclusion This case underscores ATM as a rare yet reversible neurological complication of dengue fever. Early recognition and diagnosis through neuroimaging and exclusion of other causes, followed by timely initiation of high-dose corticosteroids and immunomodulatory therapy, can lead to favorable outcomes. Awareness of this association is very crucial in endemic regions of dengue to ensure prompt treatment and optimal recovery.

papers.title: Non-contact fingertip video to differentiate dengue haemorrhagic fever in plasma leakage from dengue fever: A prospective proof-of-concept cohort study
papers.abstract: Most patients with dengue recover without intervention, but a minority develop plasma leakage that threatens the circulation, and differentiating them is the central problem in dengue care. Platelet count is the marker in routine serial use and is itself one of the four defining criteria of dengue haemorrhagic fever (DHF), so thrombocytopenia in dengue fever (DF) can overlap with DHF on the very marker used to distinguish them. We asked whether a non-contact optical signal carries discriminative information beyond platelet count. We conducted a prospective observational cohort study at a national dengue referral centre. All DHF recordings were obtained at or after plasma-leakage onset, so the analysis compares established clinical states rather than pre-leakage risk. Serial non-contact fingertip videos were recorded with contemporaneous clinical and haematological measurements. In a held-out set of 50 recordings (20 DHF, 30 DF), video-derived probability separated the groups with an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) of 0.963 (95% CI 0.918-1.000; 0.957 averaged across eight architectures). In the 49 recordings with a platelet count, the video AUC was 0.961 against 0.888 for platelet count (difference 0.074, p = 0.19). In exploratory analyses the video added information to platelet count (likelihood-ratio p < 0.001), showed no significant within-group correlation with platelet count, and retained an AUC of 0.970 against thrombocytopenic DF, where platelet count fell to 0.759. Bedside pulse rate, body temperature and haematocrit did not separate the groups and were unrelated to the video score. A [~]30-second fingertip video separated DHF in plasma leakage from DF in this test set, and exploratory analyses suggest it carries information beyond platelet count. These findings are proof of concept from single-centre internal validation, not evidence of pre-leakage prediction; prospective pre-leakage studies and external validation are needed to establish whether the signal can support earlier risk stratification. Author summaryDengue is common in Sri Lanka. While most patients recover, a subset experiences a critical leakage of fluid from their blood vessels, which can progress to shock, bleeding and organ dysfunction if untreated. We monitor platelet counts because they track disease progression, but counts can fall in patients who leak fluid and in those who do not, so a low count alone cannot separate the two groups. We investigated whether a brief, non-contact fingertip video could tell these groups apart, beyond platelet count. We recorded dengue haemorrhagic fever videos at or after the onset of leakage, and in test recordings held out from training, the video separated the two groups and, in exploratory analyses, appeared to add information beyond the platelet count. This held among patients with low platelet counts in both groups. This single-hospital study does not establish a diagnostic test for clinical use. Its significance is in showing that a simple optical recording can detect a difference associated with established disease. Our next question is whether this difference can be detected before leakage begins; if so, the same recording could eventually help identify, at a population level, which dengue patients are most at risk of these complications.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Dengue haemorrhagic fever (DHF) is a critical condition characterized by plasma leakage, which poses significant risks if untreated. Differentiating DHF from dengue fever (DF) remains a central challenge in dengue care due to overlapping clinical markers.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A prospective observational cohort study was conducted at a national dengue referral centre, focusing on patients with established clinical states of DHF and DF. The study included 50 recordings, with 20 DHF and 30 DF cases, all obtained at or after plasma-leakage onset.
analysis.methods: Serial non-contact fingertip videos were recorded alongside contemporaneous clinical and haematological measurements. These videos were analyzed using an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) to assess their discriminative ability compared to platelet count.
analysis.main_results: In a held-out set of 50 recordings, the video-derived probability separated DHF and DF groups with an AUC of 0.963 (95% CI 0.918-1.000). The video also showed no significant within-group correlation with platelet count and retained an AUC of 0.970 against thrombocytopenic DF, where platelet count fell to 0.759.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that a brief, non-contact fingertip video can provide discriminative information beyond platelet count, which is a key marker for DHF. This approach may offer additional insights into differentiating DHF from DF.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The study demonstrates that a simple optical recording could potentially aid in identifying patients at risk of severe dengue complications, offering a new tool for risk stratification and early intervention.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to a single-hospital setting and does not establish a diagnostic test for clinical use. The evidence is internal validation, and further prospective pre-leakage studies and external validation are needed to confirm its utility.

analysis.summary_en: This study explores the potential of non-contact fingertip video to differentiate dengue haemorrhagic fever (DHF) from dengue fever (DF) beyond traditional platelet count markers. Conducted at a national dengue referral centre, the prospective observational cohort study recorded 50 videos (20 DHF, 30 DF) at or after plasma-leakage onset. The video-derived probability separated the groups with an AUC of 0.963, showing no significant within-group correlation with platelet count. Exploratory analyses indicated that the video retained an AUC of 0.970 against thrombocytopenic DF, where platelet count was lower. While the findings are proof of concept, they are limited to a single-centre internal validation and do not establish a clinical diagnostic test. The study highlights the potential of optical recordings as a tool for risk stratification in dengue patients.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 登革出血热 (DHF) 是一种以血浆渗漏为特征的危急病症,如果不及时治疗会带来重大风险。由于临床标志物重叠,区分 DHF 和 登革热 (DF) 仍然是登革热护理中的一个主要挑战。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 一项前瞻性观察性 队列研究 研究在国家登革热转诊中心进行,重点关注已确定 DHF 和 DF 临床状态的患者。该研究包括 50 份记录,其中 20 例 DHF 和 30 例 DF 病例,全部在血浆泄漏发生时或之后获得。
elements_zh.methods: 记录连续非接触式指尖视频以及同时进行的临床和血液学测量。使用受试者工作特征曲线 (AUC) 下的面积对这些视频进行分析,以评估其与血小板计数相比的辨别能力。
elements_zh.main_results: 在保留的 50 个录音集中,视频导出的概率将 DHF 组和 DF 组分开,AUC 为 0.963 (95% CI 0.918-1.000)。该视频还显示与血小板计数没有显着的组内相关性,并且相对于血小板减少性 DF 保留了 0.970 的 AUC,其中血小板计数降至 0.759。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,简短的非接触式指尖视频可以提供血小板计数之外的辨别信息,而血小板计数是 DHF 的关键标志。这种方法可以为区分 DHF 和 DF 提供更多见解。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 该研究表明,简单的光学记录可能有助于识别有 重症登革热 并发症风险的患者,为风险分层和早期干预提供新工具。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于单一医院环境,并未建立用于临床的诊断测试。证据是内部验证,还需要进一步的前瞻性预泄漏研究和外部验证来确认其实用性。

Serial non-contact fingertip videos were recorded with contemporaneous clinical and haematological measurements. In a held-out set of 50 recordings (20 DHF, 30 DF), video-derived probability separated the groups with an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) of 0.963 (95% CI 0.918-1.000; 0.957 averaged across eight architectures). In the 49 recordings with a platelet count, the video AUC was 0.961 against 0.888 for platelet count (difference 0.074, p = 0.19). In exploratory analyses the video added information to platelet count (likelihood-ratio p < 0.001), showed no significant within-group correlation with platelet count, and retained an AUC of 0.970 against thrombocytopenic DF, where platelet count fell to 0.759. Bedside pulse rate, body temperature and haematocrit did not separate the groups and were unrelated to the video score. A [~]30-second fingertip video separated DHF in plasma leakage from DF in this test set, and exploratory analyses suggest it carries information beyond platelet count. These findings are proof of concept from single-centre internal validation, not evidence of pre-leakage prediction; prospective pre-leakage studies and external validation are needed to establish whether the signal can support earlier risk stratification. Author summaryDengue is common in Sri Lanka. While most patients recover, a subset experiences a critical leakage of fluid from their blood vessels, which can progress to shock, bleeding and organ dysfunction if untreated. We monitor platelet counts because they track disease progression, but counts can fall in patients who leak fluid and in those who do not, so a low count alone cannot separate the two groups. We investigated whether a brief, non-contact fingertip video could tell these groups apart, beyond platelet count. We recorded dengue haemorrhagic fever videos at or after the onset of leakage, and in test recordings held out from training, the video separated the two groups and, in exploratory analyses, appeared to add information beyond the platelet count. This held among patients with low platelet counts in both groups. This single-hospital study does not establish a diagnostic test for clinical use. Its significance is in showing that a simple optical recording can detect a difference associated with established disease. Our next question is whether this difference can be detected before leakage begins; if so, the same recording could eventually help identify, at a population level, which dengue patients are most at risk of these complications.

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 登革出血热 (DHF) 是一种以血浆渗漏为特征的危急病症,如果不及时治疗会带来重大风险。由于临床标志物重叠,区分 DHF 和 登革热 (DF) 仍然是登革热护理中的一个主要挑战。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 一项前瞻性观察性 队列研究 研究在国家登革热转诊中心进行,重点关注已确定 DHF 和 DF 临床状态的患者。该研究包括 50 份记录,其中 20 例 DHF 和 30 例 DF 病例,全部在血浆泄漏发生时或之后获得。
analysis_zh.methods: 记录连续非接触式指尖视频以及同时进行的临床和血液学测量。使用受试者工作特征曲线 (AUC) 下的面积对这些视频进行分析,以评估其与血小板计数相比的辨别能力。
analysis_zh.main_results: 在保留的 50 个录音集中,视频导出的概率将 DHF 组和 DF 组分开,AUC 为 0.963 (95% CI 0.918-1.000)。该视频还显示与血小板计数没有显着的组内相关性,并且相对于血小板减少性 DF 保留了 0.970 的 AUC,其中血小板计数降至 0.759。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,简短的非接触式指尖视频可以提供血小板计数之外的辨别信息,而血小板计数是 DHF 的关键标志。这种方法可以为区分 DHF 和 DF 提供更多见解。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 该研究表明,简单的光学记录可能有助于识别有 重症登革热 并发症风险的患者,为风险分层和早期干预提供新工具。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于单一医院环境,并未建立用于临床的诊断测试。证据是内部验证,还需要进一步的前瞻性预泄漏研究和外部验证来确认其实用性。

papers.title: Dengue Outbreaks in Bangladesh: From Reactive Control to Sustainable Prevention
papers.abstract: Dengue has moved from an occasional urban epidemic to a recurring national public health emergency in Bangladesh. The 2023 outbreak recorded 321,179 cases and 1,705 deaths, the highest annual toll on record, and transmission reached districts once considered low-risk. The seasons since have confirmed that the problem is persistent rather than episodic. This editorial argues that a response built around seasonal fogging, emergency hospital expansion and public appeals is no longer proportionate to the threat. Evidence from Dhaka shows intense pyrethroid resistance in Aedes aegypti, the principal vector, and many patients died within a day of admission. We outline a shift towards integrated, evidence-based prevention: resistance-guided vector management, community mobilisation, year-round surveillance linked to serotype data, early clinical recognition of warning signs at every level of care, and careful evaluation of Wolbachia releases and vaccines. Medical colleges, as teaching hospitals and training institutions, have a central role in this transition.

papers.title: Organizational barriers to addressing climate-sensitive diseases in the Global South: A case study of Peru’s dengue response
papers.abstract: To address infectious diseases such as dengue, the World Health organization advocates a 'whole-of-government' approach that promotes coordination across all levels of government within the health sector and across related sectors. Yet not all health systems have the organizational arrangements needed to facilitate such coordination. This paper examines Peru's dengue control program to investigate how the organization of the health system shapes the government's capacity to respond to public health threats. Drawing on the sociology of organizations and qualitative analysis, the study examines how decentralization and performance-based management-legacies of adopting New Public Management (NPM) principles and neoliberal reforms in the 1990s and early 2000s-shape the organizational culture and design of Peru's health system. The findings identify several barriers to coordination across government levels and policy sectors. These include cultural factors such as context-blind universalism and organizational environments that discourage public-sector entrepreneurship, as well as organizational design features such as fragmented data systems, a lack of incentives to pursue a public health career, and rigid performance-based budgeting. Together, these factors limit coordination within the health sector and hinder intersectoral collaboration. The study proposes that improving the government's capacity to respond to health threats requires integrating whole-of-government principles into existing NPM arrangements to strengthen both hierarchical and horizontal coordination.

papers.title_zh: 解决南半球气候敏感疾病的组织障碍:秘鲁登革热应对案例研究
papers.source_body_en: To address infectious diseases such as dengue, the World Health organization advocates a 'whole-of-government' approach that promotes coordination across all levels of government within the health sector and across related sectors. Yet not all health systems have the organizational arrangements needed to facilitate such coordination. This paper examines Peru's dengue control program to investigate how the organization of the health system shapes the government's capacity to respond to public health threats. Drawing on the sociology of organizations and qualitative analysis, the study examines how decentralization and performance-based management-legacies of adopting New Public Management (NPM) principles and neoliberal reforms in the 1990s and early 2000s-shape the organizational culture and design of Peru's health system. The findings identify several barriers to coordination across government levels and policy sectors. These include cultural factors such as context-blind universalism and organizational environments that discourage public-sector entrepreneurship, as well as organizational design features such as fragmented data systems, a lack of incentives to pursue a public health career, and rigid performance-based budgeting. Together, these factors limit coordination within the health sector and hinder intersectoral collaboration. The study proposes that improving the government's capacity to respond to health threats requires integrating whole-of-government principles into existing NPM arrangements to strengthen both hierarchical and horizontal coordination.

papers.title: Computational Insights Into the Conformational Dynamics of the Dengue Virus Capsid Protein.
papers.abstract: The Dengue virus (DENV) capsid protein plays an important role in the viral lifecycle, including encapsidation of the genome, recruitment of lipid droplets, and assembly of particles. Capsid protein includes a hydrophobic pocket, which plays a central role in these functions and switches between closed and open conformations. This work studies the conformational change pathway of the capsid protein, specifically how the molecular mechanisms controlling the opening and closing of the hydrophobic pocket are controlled. By using a combination of different types of molecular dynamics simulations and enhanced sampling methods, we share insights on the structural rearrangements that play a crucial role in governing these transitions. Our results show that lipid binding modulates the accessibility of the hydrophobic pocket through environmental cues. In the open conformation, the pocket is involved in the interaction with lipids, stabilization of capsid dimers, and the promotion of immature virus assembly. Conversely, the closed conformation protects the hydrophobic pocket from the surrounding aqueous media as also preventing premature interactions in the solution phase that might disrupt protein stability. Such insights allow a deep understanding of capsid protein's conformational dynamics and represent a promising set of potent targets for antiviral strategies aiming to interfere with its functional transitions.

papers.abstract_zh: 登革病毒 (DENV) 衣壳蛋白在病毒生命周期中发挥重要作用,包括 基因组 的衣壳化、脂滴的招募和颗粒的组装。衣壳蛋白包含一个疏水口袋,它在这些功能以及闭合和开放构象之间的转换中发挥着核心作用。这项工作研究了衣壳蛋白的构象变化途径,特别是如何控制控制疏水袋打开和关闭的分子机制。通过结合使用不同类型的分子动力学模拟和增强的采样方法,我们分享了对在控制这些转变中发挥关键作用的结构重排的见解。我们的结果表明,脂质结合通过环境因素调节疏水袋的可及性。在开放构象中,口袋参与与脂质的相互作用、衣壳二聚体的稳定以及促进未成熟病毒的组装。相反,闭合构象可以保护疏水袋免受周围水介质的影响,同时还可以防止溶液相中过早的相互作用,从而破坏蛋白质的稳定性。这些见解使人们能够深入了解衣壳蛋白的构象动力学,并为旨在干扰其功能转变的 抗病毒药物 策略提供了一组有前景的有效靶标。

papers.title: Host Genetics, Population Diversity, and Dengue Infection: An Unsolved Paradigm
papers.abstract: This narrative review examines recent literature on human genetic variation and the clinical spectrum of dengue. A comprehensive search through September 2026 synthesized findings from genetic association studies, HLA typing, and genome-wide studies. The evidence is systematically categorized according to the World Health Organization clinical classification. The majority of available data derive from investigations conducted in Southeast Asia, with limited contributions from Africa and Latin America. Notably, specific HLA alleles—particularly HLA-A*24—as well as MICB and PLCE1 gene variants demonstrate the strongest associations with severe dengue; however, these associations vary by population and viral serotype. Other immune response genes, including CD209, FCGR2A, and TNF, have also been implicated, although their effects exhibit inconsistency across diverse cohorts and epidemiological settings. Conversely, the impact of certain variants, such as FCGR2A R/R131, appears to be modulated by population context, infecting serotype, and infection history. A major limitation of the existing body of research is the prevalence of small sample sizes, heterogeneity in case definitions across guidelines, and insufficient adjustment for genetic diversity. To date, no genetic marker has been validated for routine clinical use on a global scale; nevertheless, large-scale genetic analyses have yielded novel insights that warrant further investigation in large, multi-ethnic studies integrating both host and viral genomic data. Genetic analyses are crucial for improving vaccine efficacy and for identifying therapeutic targets to prevent dengue infection and reduce the risk of severe disease.

papers.abstract_zh: 这篇叙述性综述考察了有关人类遗传变异和登革热临床谱的最新文献。截至 2026 年 9 月的全面检索综合了遗传关联研究、HLA 分型和 基因组 范围研究的结果。证据根据世界卫生组织临床分类进行系统分类。大多数可用数据来自在东南亚进行的调查,非洲和拉丁美洲的贡献有限。值得注意的是,特定的 HLA 等位基因(尤其是 HLA-A*24)以及 MICB 和 PLCE1 基因变体证明与 重症登革热 的关联性最强;然而,这些关联因人群和病毒血清型而异。其他 免疫应答 基因,包括 CD209、FCGR2A 和 TNF,也受到影响,尽管它们的作用在不同的 队列研究 和流行病学环境中表现出不一致。相反,某些变异(例如 FCGR2A R/R131)的影响似乎受到人群背景、感染血清型和感染史的调节。现有研究的一个主要限制是样本量小、不同指南中病例定义的异质性以及对遗传多样性的调整不足。迄今为止,还没有任何遗传标记被验证可在全球范围内常规临床使用;尽管如此,大规模的遗传分析已经产生了新颖的见解,值得在整合 宿主 和病毒基因组数据的大型多种族研究中进行进一步调查。遗传分析对于提高 疫苗 疗效以及确定预防登革热感染和降低严重疾病风险的治疗靶点至关重要。

analysis_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 特定的 HLA 等位基因(尤其是 HLA-A*24)以及 MICB 和 PLCE1 基因变异表明与 重症登革热 的关联性最强;然而,这些关联因人群和病毒血清型而异。其他 免疫应答 基因,包括 CD209、FCGR2A 和 TNF,也受到影响,尽管它们的作用在不同的 队列研究 和流行病学环境中表现出不一致。某些变异(例如 FCGR2A R/R131)的影响似乎受到人群背景、感染血清型和感染史的调节。
analysis_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 现有研究的一个主要限制是样本量小、不同指南中病例定义的异质性以及对遗传多样性的调整不足。
analysis_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 遗传分析对于提高 疫苗 疗效以及确定预防登革热感染和降低严重疾病风险的治疗靶点至关重要。

papers.title: Characterization of Pathogenic Features of Dengue Virus Serotypes 1–4 in the AG129 Mouse Model
papers.abstract: An AG129 mouse infection model with four DENV isolates was established to systematically characterize the early pathogenic phenotypes of these strains. DENV-1 caused 100% mortality by 15 dpi, with sustained viremia, widespread multi-organ injury, and persistent leukopenia. DENV-4 exhibited peak viremia at 4 dpi and unique neurovirulence, presenting exclusive hind-limb paralysis, severe pulmonary hemorrhage, and characteristic cerebral parenchymal lesions. DENV-2 and DENV-3 induced only transient mild viremia and focal tissue alterations without mortality. Hematological and biochemical alterations, as well as occasional splenic hemosiderin deposition, were noted among infected animals. This preclinical dataset offers insights into serotype-specific DENV pathogenesis and may aid future evaluation of broad-spectrum antivirals and tetravalent vaccine candidates.

analysis.study_design_and_population: The study used an AG129 mouse model infected with four DENV isolates to evaluate serotype-specific pathogenic features across different time points post-infection.
analysis.methods: The researchers established an AG129 mouse infection model with four DENV isolates and monitored hematological, biochemical, and histopathological changes in infected animals.
analysis.main_results: DENV-1 caused 100% mortality by 15 dpi, with sustained viremia, widespread multi-organ injury, and persistent leukopenia. DENV-4 exhibited peak viremia at 4 dpi and unique neurovirulence, presenting exclusive hind-limb paralysis, severe pulmonary hemorrhage, and characteristic cerebral parenchymal lesions. DENV-2 and DENV-3 induced only transient mild viremia and focal tissue alterations without mortality.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings highlight serotype-specific differences in pathogenesis, providing a preclinical dataset that may inform future antiviral and vaccine development.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results offer insights into the differential pathogenic mechanisms of DENV serotypes, which could guide the development of broad-spectrum antivirals and tetravalent vaccine candidates.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to a preclinical model, and the evidence is based on observations from an abstract-only dataset, which may not fully capture human disease complexity.

analysis.summary_en: This study used an AG129 mouse model to characterize the early pathogenic features of Dengue virus serotypes 1–4. It found that DENV-1 caused 100% mortality by 15 dpi with sustained viremia and multi-organ injury, while DENV-4 showed unique neurovirulence with hind-limb paralysis and cerebral lesions. DENV-2 and DENV-3 induced only transient mild viremia and focal tissue changes without mortality. The research highlights serotype-specific pathogenic differences, which may inform future antiviral and vaccine development. The study is limited to a preclinical model and relies on abstract-only data, which may not fully represent human disease. The findings provide a foundation for understanding DENV pathogenesis and could guide the evaluation of broad-spectrum antivirals and tetravalent vaccines.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在使用 AG129 小鼠感染模型系统地表征 登革病毒 血清型 1-4 的早期致病表型。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究使用感染四种登革热病毒分离株的 AG129 小鼠模型来评估感染后不同时间点的血清型特异性致病特征。
elements_zh.methods: 研究人员用四种登革热病毒分离株建立了 AG129 小鼠感染模型,并监测了感染动物的血液学、生化和组织病理学变化。
elements_zh.main_results: DENV-1 在 15 dpi 时导致 100% 死亡率,伴有持续病毒血症、广泛的多器官损伤和持续性白细胞减少症。DENV-4 在 4 dpi 时表现出病毒血症峰值和独特的神经毒力,表现为独特的后肢麻痹、严重肺出血和特征性脑实质病变。DENV-2和DENV-3仅诱导短暂的轻度病毒血症和局部组织改变,而没有死亡率。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果强调了 发病机制 中血清型特异性的差异,提供了可能为未来 抗病毒药物 和 疫苗 开发提供信息的临床前数据集。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果提供了对 DENV 血清型差异致病机制的见解,可以指导广谱 抗病毒药物 和四价 疫苗 候选药物的开发。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于临床前模型,证据基于仅抽象数据集的观察,该数据集可能无法完全捕捉人类疾病的复杂性。

analysis_zh.main_results: DENV-1 在 15 dpi 时导致 100% 死亡率,伴有持续病毒血症、广泛的多器官损伤和持续性白细胞减少症。DENV-4 在 4 dpi 时表现出病毒血症峰值和独特的神经毒力,表现为独特的后肢麻痹、严重肺出血和特征性脑实质病变。DENV-2和DENV-3仅诱导短暂的轻度病毒血症和局部组织改变,而没有死亡率。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果强调了 发病机制 中血清型特异性的差异,提供了可能为未来 抗病毒药物 和 疫苗 开发提供信息的临床前数据集。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果提供了对 DENV 血清型差异致病机制的见解,可以指导广谱 抗病毒药物 和四价 疫苗 候选药物的开发。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于临床前模型,证据基于仅抽象数据集的观察,该数据集可能无法完全捕捉人类疾病的复杂性。

papers.title: The role of interferon-stimulated long non-coding RNA PKR-IT1 in the regulation of Zika virus and dengue virus replication and antiviral response
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Interferon-stimulated genes play a critical role in the innate immune response against flaviviral infection. While recent studies have reported that interferon-stimulated lncRNAs participate in antiviral immunity, the functions of numerous lncRNAs in host-flavivirus interactions remain uncharacterized. Here, we demonstrate that the expression of lncRNA PKR-IT1 is induced by ZIKV and DENV infection. PKR-IT1 was induced by virus, poly(I:C), and IFNs in A549 cells, but this induction was largely abolished upon knockout of IPS-1 or IFNAR1 during viral infection. Additionally, PKR-IT1 overexpression inhibited viral production, whereas its suppression in A549, Huh7, and SH-SY5Y cells enhanced ZIKV replication. In PKR-IT1 knockout cells, viral replication also markedly increased compared with that in control cells. Interestingly, PKR-IT1 overexpression enhanced the activation of the JAK-STAT signaling pathway triggered by flaviviral infection and upregulated ISG expression. Conversely, PKR-IT1 deficiency decreased JAK1 and STAT1 phosphorylation levels, thereby impairing ISG expression. Mechanistically, the silencing of STAT1 in PKR-IT1-overexpressing cells partially restored ZIKV replication. Furthermore, PKR-IT1 directly bound PABPC1 and promoted its proteasome-dependent degradation. PABPC1 was found to bind to ZIKV RNA, while the inhibition of PABPC1 attenuated the levels of ZIKV protein, viral particles, and later viral RNA. Notably, the reintroduction of PABPC1 restored viral replication in PKR-IT1-overexpressing cells. Clinically, PKR-IT1 levels negatively correlate with fever duration and symptom number, and are lower in DENV-infected patients with severe leukopenia and thrombocytopenia. In summary, PKR-IT1 modulates flavivirus replication and JAK-STAT signaling, and may serve as a clinical correlate of dengue severity, offering insights for antiviral therapy development. IMPORTANCE Flaviviruses such as ZIKV and DENV pose significant public health threats, yet the roles of long non-coding RNAs (lncRNAs) in host antiviral immunity remain poorly understood. Here, we identified that PKR-IT1, as an interferon-stimulated lncRNA, not only suppresses flavivirus replication by binding PABPC1 to promote its proteasome-mediated degradation, but also enhances the activation of the JAK-STAT signaling cascade during flavivirus infection. Importantly, clinical correlations reveal that lower PKR-IT1 expression is associated with severe leukopenia and thrombocytopenia in DENV-infected patients, as well as longer fever duration and more symptoms. These findings establish that PKR-IT1 not only acts as a novel modulator of both flavivirus replication and the JAK-STAT signaling pathway, but also may serve as a correlate of dengue disease severity. By elucidating a previously uncharacterized lncRNA-mediated regulatory mechanism, this work provides a foundation for developing therapeutic strategies and prognostic tools against flaviviral infections.
